canonical_project: C Capital / Lendlease Beveridge Northern Freight Precinct data centre assets
notes: Lendlease (official media release) says it was appointed by C Capital to progress master planning and rezoning/infrastructure enablement for a 507ha Beveridge site (Mitchell Shire) with end value up to A$4.5b spanning logistics, industrial and data centre assets; data centre scope/facility not yet defined - master-planning stage.
